name: Chorizo
siboNotes: Pure chorizo is typically FODMAP-free, but check labels for garlic or onion powder which are common additives in commercial varieties.
preparationTips: Choose Spanish dry-cured chorizo or cook fresh Mexican chorizo thoroughly
Check ingredient labels carefully - avoid varieties with garlic or onion powder
Remove casings from fresh chorizo before cooking if desired
Cook fresh chorizo over medium heat to render fat properly
